core/ai/http_util.py - shared, retryable JSON POST for online AI calls.

Both the data-reader (``data_extract``) and the recipe-inferrer
(``recipe_infer``) talk to OpenAI-compatible endpoints over stdlib ``urllib``.
This helper centralises the transport so that a single slow / transient GLM
response no longer kills a whole first-seen PO:

* transient failures (``URLError`` / ``socket.timeout`` / ``ConnectionError`` /
  ``http.client.HTTPException``) and HTTP 5xx are retried with exponential
  backoff before giving up;
* HTTP 4xx (auth / request error) is NOT retried - it would fail the same way;
* every timeout is configurable via the caller (``timeout`` / ``retries`` /
  ``backoff``), sourced from the user's config with sensible defaults.

Only stdlib is used, matching the rest of ``core/ai``.

POST ``body_dict`` as JSON to ``url`` with bearer auth; return parsed JSON.

    Retries transient failures (and HTTP 5xx) up to ``retries`` times with
    exponential backoff. Raises ``RuntimeError`` with a clear message on final
    failure so the caller can log it (and the UI can show a useful FAIL line).

    ``budget`` (seconds) caps the TOTAL time spent on this call across all
    attempts: each attempt's effective timeout is shrunk so the next attempt can
    still fit, and the loop gives up once the budget is exhausted. This keeps a
    single AI read bounded (~115s) regardless of the configured ``timeout`` or
    ``retries``.
